newsitem.title: UK: Cadbury up after finance director comments.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury up after finance director comments.

text.p: Shares in Cadbury Schweppes Plc rose on Monday after positive comments by finance director David Kappler to some 150 analysts and fund managers in New York on Friday, traders said.
The stock was up 5-1/2p at 519 by 1430 GMT.

A spokeswoman for Cadbury played down the significance of Kappler's remarks, saying they were part of a routine presentation which repeated comments made at the time of the company's first-half results last month.
Sources at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett and Kleinwort Benson denied market talk they had repeated "buy" recommendations on the stock today.
